commands.name: clm
commands.description: Show the clm ledger, budget use and recent decisions; `board` opens the issue board in the browser, `link <id>` brings another repo's issue into this session, `drop <id…|all>` drops open issues of this session (shown to you only).

tools.name: clm_recall
tools.description: Read original transcript rows by address @xxxxxxxx or an ancestor range @first..@last. Includes rows folded from the live context and rows on rewound branches.

tools.name: clm_task
tools.description: Update a task you are working on: mark it todo to record a planned step, doing when you start (declare the method you will use), done when you finish it (add evidence with the row and a verbatim quote when one shows the result), or dropped when the user abandons it, citing that user message. Create a child task for a sub-step you will do yourself.

tools.name: clm_resource
tools.description: Track resources this session owns and shared exclusive resources. Call `register` with kind `mutex` when a device or service may be used by only one session at a time; call `who` before using one; call `release` the moment you finish with it. Bash commands that start an emulator, simulator, Metro, a web dev server, or a PR are recorded automatically; `register` with kind `owned` covers anything they miss.
